functions.name: appeal
functions.doc: Ask a human arbiter: after an assessment, or if the assessor missed its deadline.

functions.name: cancel
functions.doc: Before move-in only. A funded deposit goes straight back to the tenant.

functions.name: counter_checkout
functions.doc:
The party who did NOT record the move-out report can add their own,
 once, any time before the case is assessed. The assessor sees both.

functions.name: create_lease
functions.doc: The landlord opens a lease. Attach NEAR for storage; the excess is refunded.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: file_claim
functions.doc:
Landlord claims deductions within the claim window. The undisputed part
 of the deposit is credited to the tenant immediately.

functions.name: finalize
ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
NEP-141 receiver: the tenant funds a lease with
 `ft_transfer_call(rudisha, deposit, msg = {"lease_id": N})`.
 Any mismatch panics, which makes the token refund the tenant in full.

functions.name: return_in_full
functions.doc: Landlord returns the whole deposit at move-out (the fast, good-record path).

functions.name: set_roles
functions.doc:
Changes the assessor and arbiter for leases created from now on.
 Existing leases keep the ones they were created with.

functions.name: sign_checkin
functions.doc:
Both parties sign the same move-in report hash. Signing a different
 hash replaces the report and resets the other party's signature.

functions.name: submit_checkout
functions.doc:
Either party records the move-out report once the lease has ended.
 This opens the landlord's claim window.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc: Pull your credited balance. On a failed transfer the balance is restored.
